title: BRETT FRANKE TRIO
tickerText: BRETT FRANKE'S MUSIC LIVES SOMEWHERE BETWEEN BLUES, ROOTS, ROCK AND GRUNGE, DRIVEN BY THE BIG, PERCUSSIVE SOUND OF A 12-STRING ACOUSTIC GUITAR. THERE'S NOTHING OVER-POLISHED ABOUT IT — THE SONGS FEEL EARTHY, RHYTHMIC AND BUILT TO BE PLAYED LOUD IN A ROOM. ZERO RADIO MOVES FROM THE SPRAWLING "BROTHER" THROUGH "BURNING ON THE INSIDE", "SOLITUDE" AND "HOME", SHOWING A SONGWRITER MORE INTERESTED IN FEEL, GROOVE AND DYNAMICS THAN STAYING INSIDE A NEAT GENRE. RAW, INDEPENDENT AUSTRALIAN MUSIC WITH PLENTY OF BITE
